description: Transition at the cut after a clip, into the clip that touches it (video://catalog/transitions). Linked audio gets a crossfade at the same cut. kind crossfade is sound only: on a video clip it crossfades the linked audio and the picture cuts hard (use mode handles for that). mode overlap (default) overlaps the clips and moves later clips earlier; handles uses source past the cut and moves nothing. changed lists each transition added, with its track and kind. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

clip_id.description: The clip before the cut; the clip after it must touch it

mode.description: overlap: the clips overlap by the duration and later clips move earlier; handles: use source past the cut, nothing moves

other_tracks.description: overlap only: what the other tracks do. stay: they don't move, so what sits after the cut there plays later against the picture (the result warns which clips); extract: the same span comes out of them too, like range.extract, so everything stays in sync

preview.description: inline: image in the result; link: URI that renders on read; none

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one
